synth.notes:
Two-axis mirror game on a 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks (x=row). H axis row ah, V axis col av; pieces = 4-conn groups of colour-5 blocks; A5 cycles H->V->pieces (bbox order), A1-4 move the selection.
Pieces mirror across V as visible gray reflections and across H / H+V as invisible occluders. The missed step-268 mechanic: a piece touching the H axis row gets an INVISIBLE V-mirror, not the visible one (ablating this fails only step 268).
The 'reflection A3 mixed outcome' is not a reflection field: reflections are re-rendered and re-ranked (ranked over visible+invisible comps, only visible cells output).
The frame is rendered from per-block layer stacks (piece>vis refl>inv refl>target(solid)>V>H; centre = first solid else top fill), then re-extracted: wall/player comps over own ∪ 0 cells, targets merged at bbox coord diff <=4.
Unconfirmed: A5 piece order beyond the observed cases; touching pieces (no merged-piece split); does a piece on the V column change its H-mirrors? Passes stateless.
